# Celebrity Salad

Celebrity Salad is a face-to-face celebrity guessing game for parties, built for iPhone and iPad.

Official website: https://celebrity-salad.com/
Official rules: https://celebrity-salad.com/how-to-play-celebrity-salad/
Guides hub: https://celebrity-salad.com/guides/
Privacy policy: https://celebrity-salad.com/privacy/

## Core definition

Players privately submit celebrity names to create a shared pool called the Salad. The group forms two to four teams and cycles through timed turns. The exact same celebrity names are reused across three classic rounds:

1. Describe It — describe the celebrity without saying their name.
2. One Word — give exactly one clue word.
3. Act It — act the celebrity without speaking.

Each correct guess scores one point. Scores carry across all three rounds. Reusing the same names is central to the game because earlier clues become shared memories that make the later rounds possible and funnier.

## Current app format

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS / iPadOS)
- Players: 4–12
- Teams: 2–4
- Submissions per player: 2–5
- Turn lengths: 30, 45, 60 or 90 seconds
- Classic rounds: Describe It, One Word, Act It
- One shared device; players do not need individual accounts or devices
- Player, team and submitted celebrity names remain local to the device
- No account is required
- The complete custom classic game is free; curated celebrity packs are optional extras

## Related game names

Celebrity Salad belongs to the same family of party games commonly called Celebrity, Fishbowl, Salad Bowl, The Name Game and Hat Game. Groups use different house rules, but the repeated-pool format is the key shared idea.

Background guides:
- Celebrity game: https://celebrity-salad.com/celebrity-game/
